title: Bookmark My Favorites Add-On | Brilliant Directories Documentation | BD Support
content: Bookmark My Favorites Add-On Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000049688 Overview The Bookmark My Favorites add-on allows the users to identify their favorite members, articles and more on the website and bookmark that content in their account for easy access later. To bookmark posts, visitors need to sign up on the site – which increases the total registered users. This add-on will keep users coming back to manage their favorite content on the site. How To Get This Add-On Websites with the VIP Add-Ons Club automatically have this add-on available: Join The VIP Add-Ons Club Purchase Individually: Bookmark My Favorites Add-On Enabling the Add-On Enable or disable the Favorites or Likes button in Finance >> Membership Plans >> click Edit on any of the membership plans on the admin area: In the next page, go to Post Publishing to activate or deactivate the Bookmark Favorites : This option can essentially add or remove the "like" button to prevent users from bookmarking content. Check the box to turn ON the likes/favorites button and uncheck the box to turn OFF the likes/favorites button. This is how you disable or enable the bookmarks/favorites/like option. Make sure to Save the Changes. Bookmark Favorites Button Settings In the Design Settings there are settings to control the following: Favorite Icon Favorite Icon Active Color Favorite Icon Disabled Color Liking Content The button will appear in the content module of the search results: Member Dashboard When the member likes or bookmarks a post they will be able to see all of their liked content within their dashboard under the " Add to Favorites " section : When a member likes or bookmarks a listing, it will be saved under the " My Saved Members " section: Bookmark Counter There is an additional add-on that has the option to turn on a counter to see how many times it has been saved. To turn this counter on follow these steps: Bookmark Counter To select a new icon and color please see: Search Results Design Members will have the option to see how many times their post has been "saved" or "liked by other members of the website: Search Members Sorting Options Having this add-on active will show additional sorting options in the Search Members section in the admin dashboard. Members can be sorted by Most and Least likes: For additional assistance: Email support@brilliantdirectories.com or create a ticket Inside Your Account Dashboard .
